roles.name: director
roles.doc: Adjudicates: promotes or rejects other roles' proposals, requires leases on a document, adds layers, and may change anything directly (plan 06 section 6.10).

roles.name: designer
roles.doc: Gameplay and canon: quests, encounters, factions, facts, placed or not. Writes only to proposal layers it owns; a director promotes them.

roles.name: environment
roles.doc: The spatial world: terrain, props and placements that stand in a tile. Leases tiles, writes only to proposal layers it owns, and never touches records with no position; a director promotes its work.

roles.name: qa
roles.doc: Looks and reports: reads, validates, captures, benchmarks and runs the engine's checks, and changes nothing. A headless run writes back into the document, so it is not a QA method here; run one on a copy.

roles.name: performance
roles.doc: Measures and tunes: builds content into the derived-data cache and sets tunables for a benchmark, and changes no document.
